First, 06-16-1849 means June 16, 1849.  
Subtract 64 days:  
June has 30 days, so back 16 days → May 31, 1849.  
Remaining 64 - 16 = 48 days to subtract from May 31.  
April has 30 days, so May 31 back 31 days → May 1, then back 17 more days into April: April 14, 1849.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1849-04-14
